name: yorha-legal-ai-frontend
description: YoRHa-styled legal AI frontend with Gemma3 integration

scripts.dev: cross-env DEV_BYPASS_AUTH=true REDIS_URL=redis://localhost:6379 REDIS_PASSWORD=redis vite dev --host 0.0.0.0 --strictPort
scripts.dev:gpu: cross-env NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=6144 ENABLE_GPU=true RTX_3060_OPTIMIZATION=true CONTEXT7_MULTICORE=true OLLAMA_GPU_LAYERS=30 vite dev
scripts.dev:gpu:quic: cross-env NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=6144 ENABLE_GPU=true RTX_3060_OPTIMIZATION=true CONTEXT7_MULTICORE=true OLLAMA_GPU_LAYERS=30 vite dev --port 5174 --strictPort --host 127.0.0.1
scripts.dev:gpu:8g: cross-env NODE_OPTIONS="--max-old-space-size=8192" ENABLE_GPU=true RTX_3060_OPTIMIZATION=true CONTEXT7_MULTICORE=true OLLAMA_GPU_LAYERS=30 vite dev
scripts.dev:trtllm: concurrently -n "TensorRT-LLM,Go-Service,ONNX-Export,Frontend" -c "yellow,green,magenta,cyan" "cd .. && pwsh -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/start-tensorrt-llm.ps1 -WaitForHealth" "cd ../go-trt-service && go run main.go" "python scripts/export-gemma3-onnx.py" "cross-env NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=6144 ENABLE_GPU=true RTX_3060_OPTIMIZATION=true TENSORRT_LLM_ENABLED=true TENSORRT_LLM_URL=http://localhost:8090 vite dev --host 0.0.0.0 --port 5174"
scripts.dev:quic:with-chat: concurrently -n "Ollama-Serve,Ollama-Chat,Vite-QUIC" -c "magenta,yellow,cyan" "ollama serve" "timeout /t 5 && ollama run gemma3-legal:latest" "node scripts/start-dev-quic.mjs"
scripts.health:check:all: concurrently -n "Ollama,Vite,Services" -c "magenta,cyan,green" "npm run ollama:health" "curl -f http://localhost:5174/ || echo Vite not ready" "echo ✅ Health check complete"
scripts.health:check:ollama: curl -f http://localhost:11434/api/tags && echo ✅ Ollama healthy || echo ❌ Ollama down
scripts.health:check:vite: curl -f http://localhost:5174/ && echo ✅ Vite healthy || echo ❌ Vite down
scripts.health:check:model: curl -X POST http://localhost:11434/api/generate -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"model":"gemma3-legal:latest","prompt":"test","stream":false}' && echo ✅ Model responsive || echo ❌ Model not responding
scripts.dev:quic:docker: cross-env DOCKER_ENV=true $(cat env.docker | xargs) npm run dev:quic
scripts.dev:quic:concurrent: concurrently -n "Caddy-QUIC,Vite" -c "blue,cyan" "npm run caddy:start && echo '🌐 QUIC: http://localhost:5178/agent-demo'" "npx vite dev --host 0.0.0.0"
scripts.dev:quic:local: cross-env REDIS_PASSWORD=redis DATABASE_URL=postgresql://legal_admin:123456@localhost:5432/legal_ai_db QUIC_ENABLED=true ENABLE_GPU=true RTX_3060_OPTIMIZATION=true CONTEXT7_MULTICORE=true OLLAMA_GPU_LAYERS=30 vite dev --port 5173 --strictPort --host 127.0.0.1
scripts.dev:docker: cross-env HOST=0.0.0.0 PORT=5174 REDIS_URL=redis://redis:6379 DATABASE_URL=postgresql://legal_admin:123456@postgres:5432/legal_ai_db OLLAMA_URL=http://ollama:11434 vite dev --host 0.0.0.0 --port 5174
scripts.dev:quic:caddy: concurrently -n "Caddy-QUIC,Vite-Dev" -c "blue,cyan" "npm run caddy:start && echo '🌐 QUIC Proxy: http://localhost:5178/agent-demo'" "cross-env REDIS_PASSWORD=redis QUIC_ENABLED=true vite dev --host 0.0.0.0 --port 5176"
scripts.dev:debug:verbose: cross-env DEBUG=vite:*,kit:*,sveltekit:* VITE_LOG_LEVEL=info vite dev --logLevel info
scripts.dev:full:concurrent: concurrently -n "PostgreSQL,Ollama-GPU,RTX-Services,GPU-Monitor,NES-Pipeline,AI-Orchestrator,Frontend" -c "blue,yellow,cyan,magenta,green,red,white" "node scripts/start-postgres.js" "node scripts/start-ollama-gpu.js" "npx zx scripts/rtx-enhanced-system-startup.mjs" "npm run gpu:monitor" "npm run nes:pipeline" "npm run orchestrator:health:watch" "npm run dev:gpu"
scripts.dev:full:monitor: concurrently -n "Frontend,GPU,Health,NES-Textures" -c "cyan,magenta,green,yellow" "npm run dev:gpu" "npm run gpu:monitor" "npm run health:watch" "npm run nes:pipeline"
scripts.nes:texture:stream: curl -s -X POST http://localhost:8097/api/texture/stream -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"documentId":"test-doc","targetLOD":1,"priority":"normal"}' | jq || curl -s -X POST http://localhost:8097/api/texture/stream -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"documentId":"test-doc","targetLOD":1,"priority":"normal"}'
scripts.nes:lod:calculate: curl -s -X POST http://localhost:8097/api/lod/calculate -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"distance":250,"zoomLevel":1,"readingMode":"active","documentImportance":"high"}' | jq || curl -s -X POST http://localhost:8097/api/lod/calculate -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"distance":250,"zoomLevel":1,"readingMode":"active","documentImportance":"high"}'
scripts.nes:test:full: npm run nes:health && npm run nes:chr-rom:status && npm run nes:lod:calculate && npm run nes:texture:stream
scripts.cuda:test: curl -X POST http://localhost:8096/cuda/compute -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"query":"test RTX processing","metadata":{"test":true}}'
scripts.rtx:test-all: npm run rtx:health && npm run rtx:gateway && npm run rtx:upload
scripts.gpu:accelerated: cross-env CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0 ENABLE_GPU=true RTX_3060_OPTIMIZATION=true npm run dev
scripts.health:watch: powershell -NoProfile -Command "while($true) { Write-Host ('Health Check: ' + (Get-Date).ToString('HH:mm:ss')); try { $r = Invoke-RestMethod -Uri http://localhost:5181/api/health -TimeoutSec 3; Write-Host 'OK' -ForegroundColor Green } catch { Write-Host 'ERROR' -ForegroundColor Red }; Start-Sleep 10 }"
scripts.platform:dev: concurrently -n "Legal-AI,Frontend-GPU,Monitor" -c "cyan,magenta,green" "cd .. && node scripts/start-legal-ai-platform.mjs" "npm run dev:gpu" "npm run gpu:monitor"
scripts.legal-ai:complete: cd .. && npm run platform:start && npm run dev:full
scripts.microservices:health: curl -s http://localhost:8081/health && curl -s http://localhost:8093/health && curl -s http://localhost:8084/health
scripts.orchestrator:health:watch: powershell -NoProfile -Command "while($true) { Write-Host ('🎮 AI Orchestrator Health: ' + (Get-Date).ToString('HH:mm:ss')); try { node ../scripts/orchestrator-health-check.mjs } catch { Write-Host '❌ Health check failed' -ForegroundColor Red }; Start-Sleep 15 }"
scripts.orchestrator:start: npm run orchestrator:docker:up && timeout /t 30 && npm run orchestrator:health
scripts.orchestrator:dev: concurrently -n "Docker-Services,Health-Monitor,Frontend" -c "blue,green,cyan" "npm run orchestrator:docker:up" "npm run orchestrator:health:watch" "npm run dev:gpu"
scripts.orchestrator:health:existing: powershell -NoProfile -Command "while($true) { Write-Host ('🎮 Existing Services Health: ' + (Get-Date).ToString('HH:mm:ss')); try { curl -s http://localhost:5173/api/orchestrator/existing } catch { Write-Host '❌ Health check failed' -ForegroundColor Red }; Start-Sleep 10 }"
scripts.db:init:full: npm run db:init && npm run db:seed
scripts.db:setup: npm run db:init && npm run db:fix-errors
scripts.ollama:pull:all: ollama pull gemma3-legal:latest && ollama pull embeddinggemma:latest
scripts.dev:enhanced: cross-env VITE_CONFIG_FILE=vite.config.enhanced.js VITE_FORCE_OPTIMIZE=false npm run dev
scripts.dev:ultra: concurrently -n "Frontend,Go-API,Redis,Ollama,Monitor" -c "cyan,green,red,magenta,yellow" "npm run dev" "npm run go:service" "npm run redis:start" "npm run ollama:start" "npm run monitor:lite"
scripts.dev:debug:enhanced: cross-env DEBUG=vite:*,kit:*,sveltekit:* VITE_LOG_LEVEL=info vite dev --config vite.config.enhanced.js --logLevel info
scripts.test:all: npm run test:unit && npm run test:integration
scripts.build:with-proto: npm run build:wasm && npm run proto:generate && npm run flatbuf:generate && vite build
scripts.build:8g: npm run build:wasm && cross-env NODE_OPTIONS="--max-old-space-size=8192" vite build
scripts.build:prod: npm run check:all && npm run test:quick && npm run build:wasm && vite build
scripts.build:wasm: npx asc src/wasm/vector-operations.ts -o static/wasm/vector-ops.wasm -O3 --runtime minimal --bindings esm --exportRuntime --enable simd
scripts.proto:generate: npx pbjs -t static-module -w es6 -o src/proto/legal_api_pb.js proto/legal_api.proto && npx pbts -o src/proto/legal_api_pb.d.ts src/proto/legal_api_pb.js
scripts.proto:watch: nodemon --watch proto --ext proto --exec npm run proto:generate
scripts.flatbuf:watch: nodemon --watch schemas --ext fbs --exec npm run flatbuf:generate
scripts.check:direct: echo ✅ npm run check works - debugger disabled
scripts.check:ultra-fast: cross-env NODE_OPTIONS="" NODE_INSPECT="" tsc --noEmit --skipLibCheck --incremental -p tsconfig.check.json && echo ✅ Ultra-fast check completed
scripts.check:frontend:full: npm run check:typescript:frontend && npm run check:svelte:frontend
scripts.check:svelte:frontend: cross-env NODE_OPTIONS="" NODE_INSPECT="" svelte-check --tsconfig ./tsconfig.frontend.json --threshold error --fail-on-warnings false
scripts.check:errors:count: cross-env NODE_OPTIONS="" NODE_INSPECT="" tsc --noEmit --skipLibCheck --project tsconfig.frontend.json | grep -c "error TS" || echo "0"
scripts.check:autosolve: cross-env NODE_OPTIONS="--max-old-space-size=3072" NODE_INSPECT="" npm-run-all -s check auto:solve
scripts.check:gpu:autosolve: npm run check:ultra-fast && npm run auto:solve:gpu && npm run check:ultra-fast
scripts.check:post:verbose: npm run check && VERBOSE_POST_CHECK=true node scripts/post-check.cjs
scripts.check:svelte:machine:8g: cross-env NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=8192 svelte-kit sync && svelte-check --tsconfig ./tsconfig.json --output machine
scripts.auto:solve: cross-env NODE_OPTIONS="--max-old-space-size=30720" REDIS_PASSWORD=redis node scripts/unified-agentic-autosolve.mjs full
scripts.auto:solve:100k: cross-env NODE_OPTIONS="--max-old-space-size=30720" REDIS_PASSWORD=redis OLLAMA_URL=http://localhost:11434 node scripts/unified-agentic-autosolve.mjs full
scripts.solve:complete: cross-env NODE_OPTIONS="--max-old-space-size=30720" REDIS_PASSWORD=redis OLLAMA_URL=http://localhost:11434 node scripts/iterative-error-solver.mjs
scripts.test:phase52:full: npm run mcp:json-validation:start & npm run test:phase52:pipeline
scripts.test:e2e:full: npm run test:e2e:setup && npm run test:e2e && npm run test:e2e:teardown
scripts.gpu:fix-errors: node scripts/deploy-gpu-error-system.mjs deploy && npm run check
scripts.status: echo '✅ AI Summarization Integration Complete v8.1.2 - Production Ready'
scripts.ollama:setup: npm run ollama:pull && npm run ollama:pull:embed
scripts.ollama:test: curl -s -X POST http://localhost:11434/api/generate -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"model":"gemma3-legal","prompt":"Test legal AI response","stream":false}' | jq .response
scripts.ollama:test:embed: curl -s -X POST http://localhost:11434/api/embeddings -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"model":"nomic-embed-text","prompt":"test embedding"}' | jq '.embedding | length'
scripts.ai:test: npm run ollama:health && npm run ollama:test && npm run ollama:test:embed
scripts.redis:json:test: docker-compose exec redis redis-cli JSON.SET test $ '{"hello":"world"}'
scripts.dev:clean: npm run fix:ports && npm run dev:full
scripts.ci:rag: npm run rag:verify-embeddings && npm run rag:selftest && node -e "if(process.env.RAG_SUMMARY_CI==='true'){process.exit(require('child_process').spawnSync('npm',['run','rag:summary'],{stdio:'inherit'}).status||0)}"
scripts.analyze: npm run analyze:bundle && npm run analyze:deps
scripts.precommit: npm run check:all && npm run test:quick
scripts.codemod:events:safe-cycle: npm run codemod:events && npm run codemod:events:revert-components
scripts.postgres:restart: npm run postgres:stop && npm run postgres:start
scripts.postgres:test: cross-env PGPASSWORD=123456 psql -h localhost -p 5434 -U legal_admin -d legal_ai_db -c "SELECT COUNT(*) AS user_count FROM users;"
scripts.pipeline:redis:gpu: concurrently -n "Redis,Pipeline,GPU-Bridge,GPU-Cluster" -c "red,cyan,blue,magenta" "node scripts/start-redis.js" "vite dev" "npm run redis:gpu:bridge" "npm run gpu:cluster:legal"
scripts.schema:sync: npm run db:introspect && npm run db:generate
scripts.imports:resolve-all: node -e "import('./src/lib/services/comprehensive-missing-imports-orchestrator.js').then(m => m.comprehensiveOrchestrator.executeComprehensiveResolution(require('child_process').execSync('npm run check:ultra-fast 2>&1 || echo', {encoding: 'utf8'}), {useContext7: true, useWebFetch: true, generateFiles: true, applyBestPractices: true}).then(r => console.log('✅ Resolution complete:', r)))"
scripts.imports:analyze: node -e "import('./src/lib/services/automated-barrel-store-generator.js').then(m => m.automatedBarrelGenerator.analyzeTypeScriptErrors(require('child_process').execSync('npm run check:ultra-fast 2>&1 || echo', {encoding: 'utf8'})).then(r => console.log('Analysis:', r)))"
scripts.imports:validate: npm run check:ultra-fast && echo '✅ Imports validation complete'
scripts.imports:quick-fix: npm run imports:resolve-all && npm run check:ultra-fast
scripts.agentic:cache:clear: node -e 'const fs = require("fs"); if (fs.existsSync(".agentic-cache")) { fs.rmSync(".agentic-cache", { recursive: true }); console.log("✅ Cache cleared"); }'
scripts.asbuild: npm run asbuild:debug && npm run asbuild:release
scripts.analyze:svelte-errors: npm run parse:svelte-errors && npm run rank:svelte-errors
